annotation.authors_or_issuer: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA)
key_provisions_or_claims: Seeks evidence to shape MHRA's new regulatory framework for AI in healthcare, with Commission recommendations due in 2026.
Asks whether the current medical device framework needs minor, significant or complete reform.
Probes pre- and post-market surveillance, including continuous learning, foundation models and agentic AI.
Asks how liability and responsibility should be shared across the AI supply chain, including clinician override scenarios.
Describes the current framework: risk-class conformity assessment, Approved Bodies, and June 2025 post-market surveillance rules.
annotation.summary_en: MHRA call for evidence supporting the National Commission on the Regulation of AI in Healthcare. It seeks views on reforming the UK medical device framework for AI, covering pre- and post-market assurance, overlapping oversight, and liability across the AI supply chain. It closes 2 February 2026.
annotation.title_clean: Call for Evidence: National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare
